data.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
data.detailed_description:
THE ETERNAL PALACE

Step into the dreamscape of the Eternal Palace. You are Retla, a cat-eared dual-weapon-wielder, tasked with navigating an ever changing labyrinth that challenges every adventurer who dares enter. Each run is a test of skill, cunning, and courage.

THE DREAM LABYRINTH

Every corridor changes with each attempt, revealing new dangers, hidden treasures, and unexpected secrets. No two runs are the same: explore, adapt, and master the ever-changing maze.

MASTER THE COMBAT

Your arsenal consists in dual blades, flashy combos, and fast-paced dodges. Strike, evade, and chain attacks in a style all your own. Every enemy is a puzzle and every battle a chance to prove your skill.

ROGUELITE PROGRESSION

With every attempt, grow stronger. Unlock new abilities, weapons, and upgrades that carry over into future runs. Adapt your skills, experiment with strategies, and continue your endless journey through the ever-changing labyrinth.

FEATURES

Thrilling 3D action with responsive dual-wield combat.

Procedurally generated labyrinths full of traps, treasures, and mysteries.

High replayability with evolving challenges.

Anime-inspired fantasy world with a memorable, heroic protagonist.

ENTER THE LABYRINTH

Face various cunning enemies, unravel shifting paths, and rise stronger with each run. The Eternal Palace awaits: will you master its trials, or be lost to its mysteries forever?

Download the Free Demo Now!

 

1.  Basic Tutorial

From basic controls to practicing combos, introducing new players into the world of Eternal Palace Sakura!

 

2. Wide Variety of Enemies and Battles

Various enemies with distinct movements, each with their own attack patterns and weaknesses. Optimize your run by observing enemy behavior and strategizing efficient combat approach.

 

3. Powerful Items

Gain powerful items by visiting shops or leveling up your character. These items possess powers to enhance your abilities or providing buffs in battles, choose wisely to build your own playstyle and strategy!

 

4. Enhancing Arts (skills) and Strategy

Assign your powered-up Arts to four different buttons and expand your options in combat. Maximize your battle tactics by customizing and enhancing your Arts!

 

5. Fierce Boss Battle

Climb up the levels and aim for the next! A Boss room is implemented on the final level. Can you take down the Boss of the final level, the mighty enemy that stands out from the rest?

Revealing part of our development progress!

In the full version scheduled to be released in Q1 2026, more enemy characters will be implemented into the game, along with “Oni” and random event rooms!

Master your skills and dare to conquer the ever-ascending, endless “∞ (Infinity)” levels!

 

20+ enemy types and 50+ enhancement item types!

We aim to make this game an infinitely re-playable rogue-lite action game with sufficient resources to fuel every run.

Wishlist now on Steam, and see you at the Eternal Palace!

data.short_description: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!
data.supported_languages:
English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 or AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1050 Ti
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
